cd /workspace/tests && python3 - <<'PYEOF'
import subprocess, sys, time, json
def run(raw, label):
    t0=time.time()
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable,"-I","/workspace/submission/main.py"], input=raw, capture_output=True, timeout=60)
    dt=time.time()-t0
    ok = p.returncode == 0
    try:
        out = json.loads(p.stdout)
    except Exception as e:
        out = "UNPARSEABLE: %r" % p.stdout[:200]
    print("%-28s rc=%s %.2fs out=%s stderr=%r" % (label, p.returncode, dt, str(out)[:70], p.stderr[:100]))

# deeply nested arrays
run(b'{"zones":' + b'['*100000 + b']'*100000 + b',"profiles":[],"queries":[],"observations":[]}', "deep nest 100k")
run(b'{"zones":' + b'['*5000 + b']'*5000 + b',"profiles":[],"queries":[],"observations":[]}', "deep nest 5k")
run(b'{"zones":' + b'['*31 + b']'*31 + b',"profiles":[],"queries":[],"observations":[]}', "nest 31")
# oversized input > 8MiB
big = b'{"zones":[],"profiles":[],"queries":[],"observations":[],"pad":"' + b'x'*(9*1024*1024) + b'"}'
run(big, "9MiB input")
# exactly 8MiB-ish valid doc padded
pad = 8*1024*1024 - 100
big2 = b'{"zones":[],"profiles":[{"id":"p","max_aliases":0,"cname":"follow","wildcard":"rfc"}],"queries":[],"observations":[],"pad":"' + b'x'*pad + b'"}'
print("size", len(big2))
run(big2, "8MiB input (extra key)")
# random binary garbage
import os
run(os.urandom(5000), "random bytes")
# truncated json
run(b'{"zones":', "truncated")
# valid but huge TXT
run(json.dumps({"zones":[],"profiles":[{"id":"p","max_aliases":0,"cname":"follow","wildcard":"rfc"}],
  "queries":[{"id":"q","name":"a.","type":"TXT","cost":1}],"observations":[]}).encode(), "minimal valid")
PYEOF
